summary: Move the -way-na example from Infectum to Infectum-wa.
rationale: The quoted verb gə-mʕambrí-way-na contains the past habitual -way-na ending. The supplied JL 13.12/13 confirms gəmʕambriwayna, and the translation is past (“wir füllten”). Both form and context establish Infectum-wa rather than unmarked Infectum.
